formats.key: blueBundlesV1SupplyCollateralAndBorrow((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 collateralAssets, uint256 borrowAssets, uint256 maxLtv, (uint8 kind, bytes data) collateralPermit, ((uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) signature, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline) signedAuthorization, (address vault, address adapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, bool fromIdle, address sourceAdapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) sourceMarketParams, uint128 assets, uint64 penalty)[] reallocations, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends collateralAssets of the collateral token to the bundler, or sends msg.value of native currency that the bundler wraps into the collateral token.
The bundler supplies that collateral to Morpho Blue on behalf of the signer, so the signer's collateral position grows.
The bundler borrows borrowAssets of the loan token on behalf of the signer, so the signer's debt grows by borrowAssets.
The signer receives borrowAssets minus the reallocation penalties minus the referral fee, in the loan token.
The referral fee, (borrowAssets - penalties) * referralFeePct / WAD, goes to referralFeeRecipient.
Each public reallocation costs assets * penalty / WAD of the loan token, taken from the borrowed amount.
With a non-empty signedAuthorization, the signer gives the bundler permanent authorization over all of the signer's Morpho Blue positions.
The call reverts if the signer's resulting LTV is above maxLtv.
formats.shown: Intent 'Supply collateral and borrow' with the loan and collateral tokens, the collateral amount, 'Borrow before fees', the reallocation amounts and penalty rates, max LTV, referral fee rate and recipient, and the bundler access date.

findings.title: SupplyCollateralAndBorrow intent always says supply and borrow, also when one of the two amounts is zero.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: "intent": "Supply collateral and borrow", no interpolatedIntent; fields collateralAssets and borrowAssets hidden with ifNotIn ["0"]. Case 2: collateralAssets = 0 and the mined cbBTC transfer is 0, but the reader lists 'Collateral token ... to Morpho market' as leaving. Case 1: borrowAssets = 0 and the mined WETH transfer is 0, but the reader expects 'Borrowed loan token 0x4200...0006' to arrive.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Supply {#.collateralAssets} and borrow {#.borrowAssets}", and show both amounts always so a zero is shown as zero.

findings.title: SupplyCollateralAndBorrow does not say that reallocation penalties and the referral fee reduce the borrowed amount the signer receives.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1SupplyCollateralAndBorrow: `uint256 receivedAssets = borrowAssets - penaltyAssets; ... safeTransfer(loanToken, msg.sender, receivedAssets - referralFeeAssets);` Descriptor labels: 'Borrow before fees', 'Liquidity moved in', 'Liquidity penalty'. Case 6: the reader writes 'Possibly 0.555556187772386348 WETH of liquidity moved in. The screen doesn't say whether this comes from me'.
findings.fix: Rename the reallocation fields to 'Vault liquidity moved (not yours)' and 'Penalty you pay, % of moved liquidity'. Rename 'Borrow before fees' to 'Debt added (you receive less fees and penalties)'.

findings.title: SupplyCollateralAndBorrow shows the Morpho Blue authorization grant only as a date, without its scope.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.setAuthorizationWithSig: `Authorization(msg.sender, address(this), true, nonce, deadline)` gives the bundler permanent rights over all of the signer's Morpho Blue positions. Descriptor: label 'Bundler access (no expiry), signature valid until' on #.signedAuthorization.deadline; the intent does not mention it.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Grants bundler permanent control of your Morpho positions; signature valid until'.

cases.notes: USDS out and USDC in match the 'Collateral to supply' and 'Borrow before fees' fields; no fee or penalty.
Only VVV leaves. The borrow is 0, but the intent says borrow and the reader expects WETH to arrive.
Only 200 USDC arrives. The collateral is 0, but the reader thinks some collateral leaves because of the intent.
0.002 ETH out is shown as 'Native collateral'; 20 USDC in is shown.
The signer receives 0.5 USDC net. The screen shows 0.5005 before a 0.1% fee, so the net amount must be worked out. The reader worked it out.
0.5 WETH in, with a 0% penalty. The reader did not understand the 'Liquidity moved in' field.

formats.key: blueBundlesV1RepayAndWithdrawCollateral((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 repayAssets, uint256 repayShares, uint256 maxRepayAssets, uint256 collateralAssets, uint256 maxLtv, (uint8 kind, bytes data) loanTokenPermit, ((uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) signature, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline) signedAuthorization, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends maxRepayAssets of the loan token to the bundler, or sends msg.value of native currency that the bundler wraps.
The bundler repays the signer's debt by repayAssets or by repayShares; type(uint256).max shares repays all of the debt.
A referral fee of repaid * referralFeePct / (WAD - referralFeePct) in the loan token goes to referralFeeRecipient.
The unused rest of maxRepayAssets returns to the signer, as native currency when msg.value > 0.
collateralAssets of the collateral token leave the signer's Morpho position and go to the signer.
With a non-empty signedAuthorization, the signer gives the bundler permanent authorization over all of the signer's Morpho Blue positions.
The call reverts if the resulting LTV is above maxLtv.
formats.shown: Intent 'Repay and withdraw collateral' with the native amount, the collateral token, the repay amount or raw debt shares, the maximum spend, the collateral withdrawn, max LTV, the fee and the bundler access date.

findings.title: RepayAndWithdrawCollateral intent says repay and withdraw also when only one of the two happens.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: "intent": "Repay and withdraw collateral", no interpolatedIntent; collateralAssets is hidden when 0. Case 10: collateralAssets = 0 and no collateral moves, but the reader expects 'Collateral token 0x4200...0006 ... released ... back to you'. Case 11: no repay and the USDC transfer is 0, but the reader expects 'some loan token will likely leave your wallet'.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Repay up to {#.maxRepayAssets} and withdraw {#.collateralAssets}", and show collateralAssets always.

findings.title: RepayAndWithdrawCollateral shows debt shares raw, and the 'all debt' maximum as a 78-digit number.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1RepayAndWithdrawCollateral: `if (repayShares == type(uint256).max) repayShares = position(...).borrowShares;`. Descriptor: repayShares format 'raw'. Case 9 shows '115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935'; case 10 shows '1273423651784536'.
findings.fix: Show type(uint256).max as 'All debt', for example with a threshold message, and label other values as 'Debt shares (not token units)'.

findings.title: RepayAndWithdrawCollateral with native value shows both ETH and WETH amounts, and does not say the refund is in ETH.
findings.evidence: TokenLib.pullOrWrapNative wraps msg.value; the refund goes back as native: `IWNative(loanToken).withdraw(remainder); msg.sender.call{value: remainder}`. Case 12 shows 'Native to repay 0.22 ETH' and 'Max amount to spend 0.22 WETH'. The reader writes 'Whether you pay in ETH or WETH, or both.'
findings.fix: Change the label 'Max amount to spend' to 'Max to spend (paid in ETH if native is sent)'.

findings.title: RepayAndWithdrawCollateral shows the Morpho Blue authorization grant only as a date, without its scope.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.setAuthorizationWithSig: `Authorization(msg.sender, address(this), true, ...)`. Descriptor: label 'Bundler access (no expiry), signature valid until'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Grants bundler permanent control of your Morpho positions; signature valid until'.

cases.notes: 0.001 USDC out and 0.00000733 cbBTC in, both shown.
Net USDC out is 1444.356147, within the 1444.360225 maximum shown. The reader also wrongly expects collateral to arrive.
cbXRP in is shown. The reader wrongly expects a repay.
0.22 ETH out is shown. The reader is unsure whether the payment is ETH or WETH.

formats.key: blueBundlesV1Supply((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, (uint8 kind, bytes data) loanTokenPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends assets of the loan token to the bundler, or sends msg.value of native currency that the bundler wraps.
assets - fee is supplied to the Morpho market for the signer, so the signer's supply position grows.
A fee of assets * referralFeePct / WAD goes to referralFeeRecipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Supply {assets} to Morpho, fee included' with the amount paid including the fee, the market's collateral token and LLTV, the fee rate and the fee recipient.

formats.key: blueBundlesV1Withdraw((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 withdrawAssets, uint256 withdrawShares, ((uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) signature, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline) signedAuthorization, (address vault, address adapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, bool fromIdle, address sourceAdapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) sourceMarketParams, uint128 assets, uint64 penalty)[] reallocations, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer's supply position shrinks by withdrawAssets or by withdrawShares.
The signer receives the withdrawn assets minus the reallocation penalties minus the referral fee, in the loan token.
The referral fee, (withdrawn - penalties) * referralFeePct / WAD, goes to referralFeeRecipient.
Each public reallocation costs assets * penalty / WAD of the loan token, taken from the withdrawal, with no bound.
With a non-empty signedAuthorization, the signer gives the bundler permanent authorization over all of the signer's Morpho Blue positions.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw from Morpho market' with 'Withdraw before fees' or raw shares, the token, the market, the reallocations, the fee and the bundler access date.

findings.title: Withdraw by shares shows only a raw share count, so the signer cannot see the tokens received.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.executeWithdraw: `IMorpho(BLUE).withdraw(marketParams, withdrawAssets, withdrawShares, sender, address(this))`. Descriptor: withdrawShares format 'raw', label 'Shares to withdraw'. Case 16 shows '911387282487328', and the signer received 941.486535 USDC; the reader writes 'amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Supply shares (not token units)'. The token amount comes from storage and cannot be shown.

findings.title: Withdraw does not say that reallocation penalties, with no bound, reduce the amount the signer receives.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1Withdraw: `uint256 receivedAssets = withdrawnAssetsTransient - penaltyAssets;`. The devdoc says 'their aggregate penalty is not bounded relative to withdrawAssets'. Descriptor labels: 'Liquidity moved in', 'Liquidity penalty'.
findings.fix: Rename the penalty field to 'Penalty you pay, % of moved liquidity' and the amount field to 'Vault liquidity moved (not yours)'.

findings.title: Withdraw shows the Morpho Blue authorization grant only as a date, without its scope.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.setAuthorizationWithSig: `Authorization(msg.sender, address(this), true, ...)`. Descriptor: label 'Bundler access (no expiry), signature valid until'. In case 16 the reader is unsure 'what exactly it can do'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Grants bundler permanent control of your Morpho positions; signature valid until'.

cases.notes: 3.667289 USDC in, with no fee or penalty.
941.486535 USDC in. Only the raw share count is shown.

formats.key: blueBundlesV1MigrateBorrowPosition((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) sourceMarketParams, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) destMarketParams, uint256 maxLtv, ((uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) signature, uint256 nonce, uint256 deadline) signedAuthorization, (address vault, address adapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, bool fromIdle, address sourceAdapter, (address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) sourceMarketParams, uint128 assets, uint64 penalty)[] reallocations, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)
effects: The bundler repays all of the signer's debt in the source market.
All of the signer's collateral in the source market moves to the destination market.
The bundler borrows the repaid amount plus the referral fee plus the reallocation penalties in the destination market, as new debt of the signer.
A referral fee of repaid * referralFeePct / (WAD - referralFeePct) in the loan token goes to referralFeeRecipient.
With a non-empty signedAuthorization, the signer gives the bundler permanent authorization over all of the signer's Morpho Blue positions.
The call reverts if the destination LTV is above maxLtv.
formats.shown: Intent 'Move full borrow position from X to Y liquidation LTV, fees add to debt' with the tokens, the old and new LLTV, the new oracle and IRM, the reallocations, max LTV, the fee and the bundler access date.

findings.title: MigrateBorrowPosition shows the Morpho Blue authorization grant only as a date, without its scope.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.setAuthorizationWithSig: `Authorization(msg.sender, address(this), true, ...)`. Descriptor: label 'Bundler access (no expiry), signature valid until'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Grants bundler permanent control of your Morpho positions; signature valid until'.

findings.title: MigrateBorrowPosition reads the collateral and debt amounts it moves from storage, so no amount can be shown.
findings.evidence: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1MigrateBorrowPosition: `Position memory position = IMorpho(BLUE).position(sourceMarketParams.id(), msg.sender);` The intent says 'Move full borrow position'.
